proposal: Exclude node_modules/ (and .venv/, dist/, build/, .git/, *.min.js) from the memory_search index. EVIDENCE (hit live this drive): a memory_search for "reward design timidity trap absorbing fixed point Ouroboros" returned mostly node_modules garbage (projects/multidac-website/node_modules/..., skills/node_modules/@solana/...) as top hits, burying the relevant results. This is the repo-audit's "website node_modules pollutes the search index" finding made concrete — it degrades semantic recall, the exact tool the creative drives depend on. FIX: add those dirs to the indexer's walk-ignore list (clawd-daemon memory_search / embeddings builder). Low-risk: vendored/generated files are never the target of a memory search. Effect: cleaner top-k, faster index, smaller embeddings.npz. The search-index exclusion is daemon-internal and safe to do independently of the git-side audit recs (which stay Clayton-gated).
